reason.description: which trigger path the failed summary call belonged to. The enum keyword is outside the validator subset; the producer (bin/compact) enforces it.

detail.description: the failure detail of the last summary attempt.

last_user_seq.description: the 1-based log sequence of the log's last user_message at failure, or 0 when the log holds none. The threshold check skips while the log's last user_message seq is at or below this value; the next user message re-arms it. The minimum keyword is outside the validator subset; the producer enforces it.
